properties.name: Cheyenne Mountain Complex (NORAD Alternate Command)
properties.description: Hardened nuclear bunker built 2,000 feet into granite. 15 three-story steel buildings mounted on heavy-duty coil springs to absorb blast shockwaves.

properties.name: Raven Rock Mountain Complex (Site R / Underground Pentagon)
properties.description: Underground military command center hollowed out inside Raven Rock mountain near Blue Ridge Summit. Serves as emergency relocation for DoD leadership.

properties.name: The Greenbrier Bunker (Project Greek Island)
properties.description: Secret bunker built under the West Virginia resort with a 25-ton blast door, dormitories, hospital, and broadcast facilities for Congress.

properties.name: Mount Weather Emergency Operations Center
properties.description: Subterranean facility in the Blue Ridge Mountains designed to house senior civilian and military leaders during a national catastrophe.

properties.name: Titan Missile Museum (Complex 571-7)
properties.description: Only preserved Titan II intercontinental ballistic missile site in the world. Includes 146-foot launch duct, rocket, blast-lock doors, and underground launch control center.

properties.name: HAARP Research Facility
properties.description: High-power radio transmitter facility with 180 crossed dipole antennas used to study the ionosphere and aurora.

properties.name: Duga Over-the-Horizon Radar (The Russian Woodpecker)
properties.description: Massive steel antenna array 150m tall and 500m wide near Chernobyl. Emitted an infamous 10Hz repetitive tapping signal on shortwave worldwide.

properties.name: Derinkuyu Underground City
properties.description: Carved deep into volcanic rock extending 85 meters down across 18 levels. Accommodated up to 20,000 people with ventilation shafts, wells, and rolling stone doors.

properties.name: Svalbard Global Seed Vault (Doomsday Vault)
properties.description: Buried 130 meters into permafrost on Spitsbergen island. Designed to withstand nuclear war, asteroid strikes, and climate disasters.

properties.name: Teufelsberg NSA Listening Station
properties.description: Artificial hill built from 26 million cubic meters of WWII rubble in West Berlin, topped with iconic geodesic radomes for intercepting Eastern Bloc radio traffic.

properties.name: Burlington Bunker (Central Government War HQ)
properties.description: 35-acre subterranean city constructed 100 feet beneath an abandoned quarry in Wiltshire. Had underground hospital, bakeries, telephone exchange, and BBC studio.

properties.name: Kelvedon Hatch Secret Nuclear Bunker
properties.description: Three-level bunker 125 feet underground hidden beneath a mock ordinary farmhouse in Essex, built to sustain 600 military and civil personnel for 3 months.

properties.name: Catacombs of Paris (Ossuary & Underground Quarries)
properties.description: Over 300 kilometers of subterranean quarry tunnels beneath the streets of Paris holding remains of more than 6 million people.

properties.name: Mount Yamantau (Kosvinsky Kamen Command Center)
properties.description: Extensive military facility mined deep inside quartz mountain in the Southern Urals, connected by secret rail lines. Believed to be a nuclear command post.

properties.name: Buzludzha Monument
properties.description: Monumental saucer-shaped concrete amphitheater built atop a mountain peak, now abandoned with weather-beaten mosaics and crumbling spire.

properties.name: Door to Hell (Darvaza Gas Crater)
properties.sub_type: Perpetually Burning Natural Gas Methane Sinkhole
properties.description: 70-meter wide gas crater set on fire by Soviet engineers in 1971 expecting it to burn out in weeks; has burned continuously for over 50 years.

properties.name: Richat Structure (Eye of the Sahara)
properties.description: Concentric ring formation visible from orbit, historically used by Gemini astronauts as a landmark. Formed by a deeply eroded magmatic dome.

properties.name: Wieliczka Salt Mine Underground Cathedral
properties.description: Reaches depths of 327 meters across 287 kilometers of tunnels, featuring subterranean saline lakes, chapels, and statues sculpted out of rock salt.

properties.name: Area 51 (Groom Lake / Homey Airport)
properties.sub_type: Classified US Air Force Flight Test Facility
properties.description: Remote detachment of Edwards AFB inside Nevada Test and Training Range, birthplace of the U-2, SR-71 Blackbird, and F-117 Nighthawk.

properties.name: Pine Gap Joint Defence Facility
properties.sub_type: Satellite Ground Station & ECHELON SIGINT Site
properties.description: Joint US-Australian surveillance station in the Outback with dozens of large radomes tracking geostationary spy satellites and intercepting telemetry.

properties.name: RAF Menwith Hill
properties.description: Known for its distinctive white golf-ball radomes; one of the largest electronic monitoring and satellite interception ground stations in the world.

properties.name: Son Doong Cave (World’s Largest Cave Passage)
properties.sub_type: Subterranean Megacave with Jungle and River
properties.description: Colossal cave passage large enough to fit an entire 40-story skyscraper city block. Has its own localized weather system, clouds, and primeval jungle inside.

properties.name: Yucca Mountain Nuclear Waste Repository
properties.description: Multi-billion dollar underground repository excavated 1,000 feet into volcanic tuff inside the Nevada desert for high-level radioactive storage.

properties.name: Maunsell Sea Forts (Red Sands & Shivering Sands)
properties.description: Stilt-mounted steel and concrete defensive towers placed in the Thames Estuary to defend against German air raids, later host to pirate radio stations.

properties.name: Wolf’s Lair (Wolfsschanze)
properties.description: Heavily fortified military headquarters in the Masurian woods with 8-meter thick reinforced concrete walls, site of the July 20 assassination attempt.

properties.name: Balleny Fracture Zone Megaliths / Oceanic Gravity Anomaly
properties.description: Deep seismic fracture zone in the Southern Ocean with unusual gravimetric variance and ultra-deep bathymetric trenches.
